Entries.Text: The project's primary bank version is older than the current game version: {0} < {1}. Open the Param Upgrader tool in the Tools window.

Upgrade this project's params to the game's current version. Each game update between the two is applied in turn: fields you changed keep your values, fields you didn't change take the update's values, and fields an update added or moved are filled in.
The Param Upgrader supports Elden Ring, Armored Core VI and Nightreign projects.
Work out the upgrade and list where your changes and the game updates disagree. Nothing in the project is changed yet.
Replace the project's params with the upgraded ones and save. With backup saves on, the old regulation.bin is kept as regulation.bin.prev.
Where your changes and a game update disagree. Your values are kept in every case; check these rows after the upgrade.
Row {0}: added by both your project and the {1} update. Your row is kept.
Row {0}, {1} ({2}): yours {3}, was {4}, update {5}. Yours is kept.
Smithbox has no upgrade data that reaches version {0}. Make it with Generate Upgrade Data below, from the regulation.bin of the version before it and the regulation.bin of {0}.

The game's regulation.bin is not version {0}, the version the Vanilla bank loaded. Reload the project and try again.

Make the upgrade data for a game version Smithbox doesn't have yet, from the regulation.bin of an older version and the regulation.bin of the newer one. The data is saved on this computer and used by the Param Upgrader from then on.
Compare the two regulations and save the upgrade data. The data is checked by rebuilding the older regulation from it.
Open the folder that holds the upgrade data made on this computer.
Select a regulation.bin for both sides.
